T: Come what may. Order the champagne.
D: A young writer falls for the star of a Paris nightclub promised to a jealous duke.
P: Serve the drinks when Toulouse brings out the green absinthe.
S: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with shallot vinegar and lemon
Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a shallot and red wine vinegar mignonette and lemon.
Warm gruyère cheese puffs with a hint of nutmeg
Choux pastry with gruyère and a pinch of nutmeg, piped into rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
the can-can dancers kicking across the stage

A whole camembert baked molten with garlic, thyme and honey, topped with a shower of roasted grapes and walnuts, with crisp baguette for dunking. Heat the oven to 180C. Score a 250g camembert, push in slivers of 1 garlic clove and thyme sprigs and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey. Roast 200g red grapes on the vine with oil and salt alongside. Bake the cheese in its box or a small dish for 15 minutes until molten. Toast 40g walnuts. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast for 8 minutes. Top the cheese with grapes, walnuts and a little more honey.
M: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce
Crisp-skinned duck breast, red wine cherry sauce and buttery mashed potatoes
Duck breast scored and rendered skin side down, roasted to pink, rested, with a cherry and red wine sauce and pommes purée.
the bohemians who come crashing through Christian's ceiling

Dry-brined sirloin seared hard in cast iron, sliced over skinny double-fried frites, with café de Paris butter melting on top and a sharp watercress salad. Salt 4 sirloin steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Mash 100g soft butter with 1 tsp Dijon, 1 chopped anchovy, 1 small garlic clove, chopped parsley, tarragon and capers, roll into a log and chill. Fry 1kg skinny cut potatoes at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 185C for 3 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side to 54C, rest 5 minutes and slice. Top with butter coins and serve with frites and dressed watercress.
W: Sweet pastry shell with vanilla custard and fresh raspberries
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with chilled vanilla crème pâtissière, covered edge to edge in raspberries and brushed with warm raspberry jam to make them shine.
K: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint
Absinthe dripped over a sugar cube, or green apple, mint and soda for everyone else
A small measure of absinthe dripped over a sugar cube into cold water until cloudy, or a sparkling green apple and mint soda.

note.text: Welcome, darlings! Tonight everything is permitted. Drinks first, tragedy later, and absolutely no talking during the show.

winks: The giant elephant in the garden

dishes.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day, shuck oysters just before serving

steps.text: Mix the shallots, vinegar and pepper for the mignonette and rest.
Shuck the oysters.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.
Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray. Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour and stir over heat for a minute.
Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs, gruyere and nutmeg.
Pipe small rounds onto the tray.
Bake until puffed and golden.

dishes.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin and render skin side down over medium heat.
Roast at 200C, then rest.
Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.

af.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin and render skin side down over medium heat.
Roast at 200C, then rest.
Simmer the cherries with the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Slice the duck and serve with the cherry sauce.

veg.n: Elephant supper portobello with cherry sauce

steps.text: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and sear gill side up in the oil over medium-high heat.
Turn, add the butter, baste and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the mash butter until silky.
Slice the mushrooms and serve with the cherry sauce and mash.

steps.text: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and sear gill side up in the oil over medium-high heat.
Turn, add the butter, baste and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the cherries with the grape juice, water, balsamic vinegar and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the mash butter until silky.
Slice the mushrooms and serve with the cherry sauce and mash.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line a tart tin and blind bake.
Cook the milk, yolks, sugar and cornflour until thick.
Chill the custard and the case.
Fill the case with custard.
Cover with raspberries edge to edge and brush with warm jam.

dishes.n: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint

ingredients.item: sugar cubes, for the grown ups

steps.text: For the grown ups, drip cold water over a sugar cube into the absinthe until cloudy.
For everyone else, blitz the apples with mint and strain.
Top with soda water and pour into small glasses.

af.n: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the star anise, caster sugar and water for 3 minutes, then cool for an aniseed syrup.
Blitz the apples with the mint and strain.
Put a splash of aniseed syrup in each small glass with ice, rest a sugar cube on a spoon over the glass and slowly drip apple juice over it until it dissolves.
Top with soda water.

s.note: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with shallot vinegar and lemon
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, then rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.

s.note: Warm gruyère cheese puffs with a hint of nutmeg
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and stir over heat for a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs, then 80g grated gruyère and a little nutmeg. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.n: Elephant supper duck with cherry sauce
m.note: Crisp-skinned duck breast, red wine cherry sauce and buttery mashed potatoes
m.how: Score 4 duck breasts and render skin side down over medium heat for 8 minutes, then roast at 200C for 5 minutes and rest. Simmer 200g pitted cherries with 200ml red wine and thyme until syrupy. Mash 1kg potatoes with 100g butter until silky.

w.note: Sweet pastry shell with vanilla custard and fresh raspberries
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick, then chill. Fill the case, cover edge to edge with 300g raspberries and brush with warm raspberry jam.

d.n: Green fairy absinthe or green apple mint
d.note: Absinthe dripped over a sugar cube, or green apple, mint and soda for everyone else
d.how: For the grown-ups, drip cold water over a sugar cube into 20ml absinthe until cloudy. For everyone else, blitz 2 green apples with mint, strain and top with soda water. Pour into small glasses.
